en-US.title: I couldn't wear the clothes I had been excitedly shopping for due to a fracture issue.. 🥳 #Taobao...
en-US.description:
Tomorrow~ This is #Dayomi, who is diligently recovering. Are you surprised by the surprise video?~~
I have nothing else to do but recuperate at home, so I'm diligently editing!! One good thing about my fracture is that I now have more time to connect with you all. It's so wonderful 🤓💛

This video was supposed to be uploaded before my kidney vlog,
but it got a little messed up due to an accident.
I also wanted to film the outfits while traveling,
but I packed them in a vertical video to check my outfits,
so I'm afraid it might be a little uncomfortable for you all to watch. 🥹 Please understand🙏🏻🥹🥹
I'd love to film them in landscape mode again,
but I can't even comfortably change my clothes on my own,
and all my luggage was sent by courier to a friend's house in China.
I think I was really crushed to death, my babies. 🥹

For those of you who are curious about my rehabilitation,
my doctor praised my recovery speed for being so fast compared to other cases.✌🏻
Watching this video now, I'm envious of how I can use my left arm and shoulder freely in the video. 🤣 But I hope you'll soon be back to being as strong as me in the video. I'll show you 💪🏻💪🏻

Then see you tomorrow 🩵🩵🩵

snippet.description:
#제품무료제공 
브랜드 닥터지 구달 어뮤즈에서 팬밋업을 위한
제 찐사용템들 제품지원을 해주셨습니다
너무감사합니다

내일 ♥ 안녕하세요 오랜만이죠 🫣
정말 한국들어온지 한달이넘었는데 너무 바쁘게 지내고 있어서 이제야 영상을 올리네요
플리마켓형식으로 진행된 제 첫 #팬밋업
정말 많은분들이 와주셔서 놀랍고 감사했어요 ♡
플리마켓 수익금은 유기견/묘센터에 내일이들 이름으로
기부될예정입니다 기부후 제 인스타에 인증남길게요
플리마켓 제품들이 저렴한편이였어서 금액이 중요하기보다는
내일이분들이 함께 참여해주신 따듯한 마음이라는것에
저는 큰의미를 가집니다..🫶🏻

오시는길이 춥고 멀었을 텐데 그리고또 대기도 많이 하셨을텐데 와주셔서 웃어주셔서 이야기나눠주셔서
너무너무 감사합니다 ☺️ 

그리고 도움을 주신 유니버스스튜디오 포노포노 유즈아 퍼프와트
그리고 스텝으로 일해준 나영 하경 다훈 정섭 정은 치치
너무 감사합니다 🫶🏻🙌🏻🙌🏻

en-US.description:
#FreeProductGiveaway

The brand Dr.G Goodal Amuse donated some of my most-used products for the fan meetup. Thank you so much.

Tomorrow ♥ Hello, it's been a while. 🫣
It's been over a month since I came to Korea, but I've been so busy that I'm only just now uploading the video.
My first #fanmeetup was held in a flea market format. I was so surprised and grateful that so many people came. ♡
The proceeds from the flea market will be donated to an abandoned dog/cat center in the names of the Naeils. I'll post a proof of donation on my Instagram. The flea market items were relatively inexpensive, so the price wasn't important, but the warmth of the Naeils participating. 🫶🏻

It must have been cold and far, and you must have waited a long time, but thank you so much for coming, smiling, and sharing stories. ☺️

And thank you to Universe Studio, PonoPono, Yuzua, Puff Watt, and Nayoung for their support. Ha Kyung, Da Hoon, Jeong Seop, Jeong Eun, Chi Chi
Thank you so much 🫶🏻🙌🏻🙌🏻
